sloka: ततो मारुतिवाक्येन क्रोदस्तस्य तदा ऽज्वलत् ।। ६.५९.६७ ।।दानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे ।संरक्तनयनो यत्नान्मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।पातयामास वेगेन वानरोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५९.६८ ।।।।
transliteration: tato mārutivākyena krodastasya tadā 'jvalat ।। 6.59.67 ।।dānīṁ durbuddhe kiṁ vikatthase ।saṁraktanayano yatnānmuṣṭimudyamya dakṣiṇam ।pātayāmāsa vegena vānarorasi vīryavān ।। 6.59.68 ।।।।

translations.english: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.
